CASE PUD 2026-000031 ENTRY NO. 114 FILED IN OCC COURT CLERK'S OFFICE ON 08/31/2026 - PAGE 1 OF 4




         BEFORE THE CORPORATION COMMISSION OF THE STATE OF OKLAHOMA

          IN THE MATTER OF THE APPLICATION OF
          OKLAHOMA GAS AND ELECTRIC
          COMPANY FOR COMMISSION APPROVAL
          OF ELECTRIC SERVICE AGREEMENTS                                PUD 2026-000031
          AND PREAPPROVAL OF CAPACITY
          PURCHASE AGREEMENTS PURSUANT TO
          17 O.S. § 286(C)



                     WITNESS AND EXHIBIT LIST OF THE ATTORNEY GENERAL

                Gentner F. Drummond, the Attorney General of Oklahoma, on behalf of the utility

         customers of this State, hereby submits this Witness and Exhibit List in the above captioned

         proceeding. The Attorney General identifies the following individual who may be called upon as

         witnesses to testify at the hearing on the merits for this proceeding:

                1. Frank J. Beling

                The Attorney General identifies the following exhibits that could be relied upon by the

         Attorney General during the hearing on the merits for this proceeding:

                1. All pre-filed testimony, including source documents, exhibits, and schedules attached

                    to or referenced in such testimony, filed by any witness on behalf of any party in this

                    proceeding;

                2. All other pleadings or documents filed with the Oklahoma Corporation Commission

                    (“Commission”) in this proceeding prior to the closing of the evidentiary record of the

                    hearing on the merits;

                3. All forms of discovery, including requests for documents, interrogatories, or otherwise,

                    issued by the Attorney General or any other party in this proceeding, together with the

                    responses and all attachments or other materials included with them, regardless of

                    confidential or highly sensitive confidential designation;

                4. All exhibits, whether marked as evidence, provided for demonstrative purposes, and/or

                    provided for impeachment purposes, introduced by any other party at the hearing on

                    the merits for this proceeding, to the extent such materials have not been excluded due

                    to an objection;

                5. All documents, charts, graphs, or other materials specifically identified in any other

                    party’s timely filed Exhibit List, to the extent such materials have not been excluded

                    due to an objection;

                6. All public filings and submissions made by any party or witness with the Commission

                    Court Clerk in Case No. PUD 2026-000046 at this Commission; and

                7. All public filings and submissions made by any party or witness with the Commission

                    Court Clerk in any other proceedings at this Commission; and

                8. All Commission rules, orders and Oklahoma Statutes.

                Further, the Attorney General reserves the right to supplement this Witness and Exhibit

         List as new information becomes available prior to the closing of the evidentiary record of the

         hearing on the merits.
